verdict.rationale: Rev AI documents an Asynchronous Speech-to-Text API that transcribes an audio file you submit. It publishes accepted formats (all FFmpeg-supported formats, including MP3, MP4, Ogg, WAV, PCM and FLAC) and limits: a 17-hour maximum duration and a 5 TB size cap. The 5 TB cap is stated only for dashboard uploads and the source_config parameter, not explicitly for direct local-file API uploads. Missing for 10: an explicit size limit for direct local-file (multipart) uploads, the endpoint path and request format quoted in the evidence, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
